translations.note: Commonly described as free for NON-COMMERCIAL Islamic educational use. Donations, advertising, or any paid tier would fall outside that. Confirm terms with Abul Qasim Publishing House before monetising the site.

translations.name: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran
translations.note: Almost literal. Author died 1936; text is public domain.

translations.name: The Holy Qur'an
translations.note: Original edition, not the 1946 Al-Rawaf printing or the King Fahd revision. Footnotes excluded.

translations.name: The Quran: A Monotheist Translation
translations.note: Translated on Quran-alone principles; renders terms from internal usage rather than classical tafsir. Confirm redistribution terms with the publisher.

translations.name: Quran in English
translations.note: Plain modern English, very low interpolation. Widely described as freely distributable; confirm before shipping.

translations.name: The Qur'an As It Explains Itself
translations.note: Expansive, self-referential method. High word count per verse; much explanatory material is unbracketed and will NOT be caught by segmentation.

translations.name: The Clear Quran — divine name as “Allah”

translations.note: Copyright Book of Signs Foundation. Actively enforced; the quran.com licence does not extend to third parties. Written permission required. Renders the divine name as God.
